candidate_next_label.definition: A device reaches at least one deliberate-play area in the 10m-to-24h label window that was absent in the first 10m feature window.

assumptions.validation: Needs product agreement on which next action is worth guiding.

assumptions.assumption: Later new area is observable without label leakage from the first 10m window.

assumptions.assumption: The current eight later-active devices are representative enough to choose a target.
